references.text: The Lord's anger burns against the people, and he threatens to wipe them out – the same theme of God's burning wrath
God's anger is like a fire that burns – parallel to 'יֶעְשַׁן אַף־יְהוָה' (the Lord's anger smokes)
The Lord threatens to blot out names from his book – parallel to bloting the name under heaven
A prayer that enemies be blotted out of the book of life – the same motif of erasing names
The Lord's zeal burns like fire – parallel to 'וְקִנְאָתוֹ' (his zeal)
The Lord's anger and zeal against the disobedient – the same theme of God's burning fury
The Lord's zeal and wrath on the day of judgment – parallel to God's burning zeal
No forgiveness remains for those who sin willfully, only terrible judgment – parallel to the Lord not being willing to forgive
A promise not to blot out names from the book of life – contrasted with the threat to erase the name
The curses that will come upon the disobedient – parallel to 'כָּל־הָאָלָה הַכְּתוּבָה בַּסֵּפֶר הַזֶּה'
